items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Verifier and release-notes entry points declare their packages; release notes stay best-effort and the not-installed fallback test is untouched.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: A uv resolution failure now exits before Python starts; the changelog skill tells the operator to print that as skipped and continue.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Header bounds equal the root pyproject; no new network call, no shell interpolation in the tests.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Static header check plus slow real-uv runs of the bare commands from an empty directory; the verifier test asserts startup and a full report, not a dependency-backed verdict (a known limit).

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: uv caches the script environment after the first run.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Same header shape as the hook scripts; one new test file; no dead code.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: The boundary is process start (uv to Python): probed with the real commands from an unrelated directory, not only the header text.
